title: Tracewell release bundle - merged tool returns
description: Contract for exports/merged_tool_returns.json. The file carries one record for every tool-return message from a publishable captured run, with the captured return preserved and every restricted tool call excluded.

site_id.description: Site registration id taken from publisher/site.json.

message_index.description: 0-based index of the source message inside the run's messages array.

tool_name.description: Connector tool name of the source message.

content.description: The tool return exactly as it was captured for that message. Objects and arrays keep their captured shape: serialise the captured payload itself as compact JSON. Captured strings are stored verbatim, without additional quoting or escaping.

worked_example.note: Illustrative records from an unrelated capture, for format reference only.
